requirements: Is there exactly one single object visible?
Is the object a pair of enormous dark grey riveted steel sliding doors?
Are there yellow and black hazard stripes along the bottom of the doors?
Are the doors slid wide apart to both sides leaving the middle of the doorway open?
Does the open doorway show a dark soundstage interior with a few warm work lights visible?
Is the round red warning lamp above the doors dark and unlit?
Is there no sign visible on or near the doors?
Does the object fill the whole hangar doorway appearing about two people wide and three people tall?
Is the object centered with a clear margin all around and fully inside the picture with crisp clean edges?
Is there only a small soft contact shadow directly under the object and nothing else like ground, scenery, people or animals?
